versions.changelog:
Initial release of wavespeed skill.

- Enables generating and editing AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) via the wavespeed CLI.
- Supports searching and selecting models, inspecting input schemas, and confirming parameters with the user before running.
- Provides recommended defaults for common tasks (image/video/audio generation and editing).
- Includes guidance for setting image and video resolutions, handling uploads, and using aliases.
- Offers comprehensive instructions for installation, authentication, and avoiding common pitfalls.
